# R4QE01 - Mario Strikers Charged
[Gecko]
$Disable Captain Mega Strikes [0BYK0]
0402f788 38600000
0402f78c 480000a0
* Disables Mega Strikes from all captains. This makes it far easier to play this game with a controller instead of a WiiMote if preferred.
